column2: Ikhawunta ematasatasa. Ayikho i-inthanethi. Kusakhishwa amabhili.
Ukuthengisa, incwadi yezikweletu, isitoko nencwadi yosuku — kumadivayisi akho. Incwadi yosuku · Thengisa · Thenga · Izimpahla. Alikho ihholo lokudlela, alikho ikhishi, awekho amatafula.
Thepha ibhili ukuze ulandele ukuthengisa ekhawunteni
Imigqa eyisibonelo yesitolo sokudla, hhayi ikhawunta yemali yangempela. I-Kirano ilandela indlela efanayo: thengisa → khokhisa → incwadi yosuku.
Thayipha i-atta, i-AT5 noma elinye igama — umugqa uwela ebhilini.
Ubuningi ngeyunithi esetshenziswa iphakethe; intengo iyalandela.
Khokhisa ekhawunteni; incwadi yosuku ibhala indlela yokukhokha.
Isikweletu ngaphandle kwe-CRM — kubhale encwadini yabo yezikweletu.
Khokha kamuva ku-Izinhlangothi — ingxenye ngokheshi, ingxenye nge-UPI, usule umugqa.
Okusele kungena encwadini yezikweletu yekhasimende — ayikho enye i-app yezincwadi.
Izikweletu zamakhasimende kuwe nezikweletu zakho kubaphakeli zisencwadini eyodwa yezinhlangothi.
Sonke isikweletu nayo yonke inkokhelo kuhlala encwadini yosuku.
Thenga kumthengisi omkhulu — isitoko nalabo obakweletayo kuvuselelwa ndawonye.
Isitoko sokuthengisa kabusha — hhayi izithako zasekhishini. Iqoqo nosuku lokuphelelwa yisikhathi kungokuzikhethela ekuthengeni.
Ibhalansi yomphakeli isehlangothini olufanayo nencwadi yezikweletu yekhasimende.
Uhlu lwesitoko lubonisa okuphelayo ngaphambi kwesixuku esilandelayo.
Ukheshi ne-UPI, kubalwe ngokwehlukana — futhi umehluko uyashiwo.
Ukheshi ne-UPI akuxutshwa neze kube yingqikithi eyodwa engaqondakali.
Vala ishifu, phrinta isiliphu, uqale elandelayo ihlanzekile.
I-invoyisi yentela noma irisidi likakheshi — umbiko wosuku uqukethe kokubili.
Incwadi yosuku · Thengisa · Thenga · Izimpahla — izikrini ezine, futhi alikho ihholo lokudlela.
Ikhawunta yemali yesibili: ixhunywe ku-Wi-Fi yakho
Uma i-inthanethi inqamuka phakathi nesixuku, akukho lutho ekhawunteni olulinda yona.
Amakhawunta emali engeziwe abelana ngezincwadi ezifanayo kunethiwekhi yesitolo.
Ayikho imali ngokuthengisa, into, ikhawunta yemali noma i-PIN yomsebenzi ekufakweni kudivayisi yakho.
I-Kirano efanayo efonini engemuva kwekhawunta nasekhawunteni yemali yekhompyutha.
Ngonyaka: Steady ₹6k · Swift ₹14k · Priority ₹28k ngaphandle kwentela (noma isilinganiso sentengo esenziwe ngokwezifiso). Thenga ku-/shop.
Dawuniloda mahhala, noma usithumelele ku-WhatsApp ukuze uboniswe ngokohlobo lwesitolo sakho nedolobha lakho.
Thepha ukuze ukhokhise — ukheshi noma i-UPI
Izifaki zizofakwa lapha uma ngasinye sesiphumelele ukufakwa emshinini omusha. Kuze kube yileso sikhathi, cela umboniso ku-WhatsApp.
Ulayini womboniso we-WhatsApp uzovuleka maduze. Umlayezo wakho uzofundeka kanje: “{message}”.
I-akhawunti eyodwa yesayithi nama-app — ifomu elifanayo noma umusha noma ubuyayo.
Sizokuthumelela isixhumanisi sokusetha kabusha nge-imeyili. Sebenzisa ikheli elifanayo obhalise ngalo.
Xhumanisa izindlela ne-akhawunti efanayo ukuze ukwazi ukubuyisa ukufinyelela uma enye yehluleka.
Izinhlelo zefu zonyaka — intela yengezwa lapho ukhokha. I-app ephelele ye-Kirano kumadivayisi akho ihlala imahhala unomphela, ngaphandle kwezikhangiso.
Inqola yakho ayinalutho. Engeza i-Steady, i-Swift noma i-Priority.
Ukukhokha kukungenisa ekhasini le-akhawunti, bese kuqala inkokhelo (ukulingisa kokuhlola noma i-Paddle uma okhiye sebesethiwe).

Izinhlelo zonyaka — isango lokukhokha lengeza intela lapho ukhokha. Ukusebenzisa kudivayisi yakho kuhlala kumahhala unomphela. Okwenziwe ngokwezifiso kuyisilinganiso sentengo (kungaba ngaphansi kwe-Steady noma ngaphezu kwe-Priority).
Imizamo eminingi kakhulu. Zama futhi emuva kwesikhathi.
Sebenzisa inombolo yocingo ephelele enekhodi yezwe (isib. +91…).
Leyo khodi ye-SMS ayilungile noma iphelelwe yisikhathi.
Ayikho i-akhawunti ene-imeyili leyo. Qhubeka ukuze uyidale, noma usebenzise enye indlela.
Ngenxa yokuphepha, ngena futhi, bese uzama lolu shintsho futhi.
Leyo ndlela yokungena isisetshenziswa enye i-akhawunti.
Sekuvele kukhona i-akhawunti ene-imeyili le esebenzisa enye indlela yokungena. Ngena ngaleyo ndlela kuqala, bese uxhumanisa le ndlela ekhasini le-akhawunti yakho.
Engeza iphasiwedi ukuze ukwazi ukungena nange-imeyili (kuyasiza uma umhlinzeki engatholakali).
Awukho umhlinzeki wangempela wokukhokha ovuliwe ku-API yefu (ukulingisa kuphela okusekudivayisi yakho).
Ukukhokha kuvaliwe — ayikho inkokhelo eqediwe. Uhlelo lwakho alushintshile.
I-imeyili ayikaqinisekiswa — bheka ibhokisi lakho lemiyalezo
I-akhawunti idaliwe. Bheka i-imeyili yakho ukuze uqinisekise uma uthola ithuba.
Uma kukhona i-akhawunti yaleyo imeyili, isixhumanisi sokusetha kabusha sisendleleni. Bheka ibhokisi lakho lemiyalezo.
I-akhawunti ka-{email} isivele ikhona nge-{method}. Ngena ngaleyo ndlela kuqala, bese uxhumanisa lo mhlinzeki ekhasini le-akhawunti yakho.
Phuma bese ungena futhi, bese uzama futhi.
I-imeyili yokuqinisekisa ithunyelwe — bheka ibhokisi lakho lemiyalezo.
Amanani okuzithengela awakashicilelwa kulo mkhiqizo. Cela isilinganiso sentengo esenziwe ngokwezifiso noma ubuye kamuva.
Umkhiqizo ophelele kumadivayisi akho. Ayikho imali yefu.
